# Photographed screen API fixture

Credit: NASA / Expedition 7 ISS crew, ISS007-E-11800, 2003-08-03.
The individual photographer is unspecified. See `source.json` for the original
source URL, both hashes, exact modification and tools. This is a resized RGB
derivative for factual technical evaluation under the
[NASA media-use guidelines](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/),
not NASA endorsement, product artwork or a repository-MIT-licensed photograph.

The screen quad and replacement gradient are independently authored MIT test
data. Static image registration does not establish automatic tracking,
photometric matching or real-footage temporal quality. Neither the photograph
nor its derivative is referenced by product resources or release packaging.
